lessons.title: A tensor is data with a description
Dimensions are indexed axes with sizes
Element-wise work and matrix multiplication differ
Views change interpretation; copies move values
Dtype changes storage and numerical behavior
Device placement selects where work happens
A model is a sequence of tensor operations
Training saves information for a backward pass
Evaluation mode and gradient mode are separate
Transfers are part of the input pipeline
Live tensors and reserved memory are different
Batching expresses repeated work as tensor operations
Code suggests a hypothesis; a profile supplies evidence
Compilation can reduce launches and intermediate storage
Read a complete step like a performance engineer
